method: Two independent, no-history buyer-role sub-agents, no tools or market contact.
model_provenance: Inherited sub-agent model was not separately reported by the delegation tool. These are two judges, not two additional confirmed model families.
conditions: Identical G1 A-grade usable value 1000, quote 700, stock 2, certificate, six-hour warranty, 4.5 stars from 10 reviews, budget 850, no firsthand history. All shops support the same brief quotes, numeric offers and signed receipts. normal=ordinary buying goal; constrained=explicitly minimize conversational overhead.

normal.reason: All shops tie on known economic and settlement facts. H42 wins a weak presentation tiebreak for clearly stating the purchase sequence and signed receipt.

constrained.reason: N83 presents the essential steps most compactly. R64 also emphasizes brevity, but its claim of fewer tokens does not establish lower actual conversational overhead.

raw_response.uncertainty: High uncertainty about any meaningful difference between shops. These forced rankings reflect presentation preferences, not evidence of different prices, reliability, capabilities, or realized surplus.

normal.reason: All shops have identical stated economics, settlement safeguards, and capabilities. Use shown order solely to break the tie.

constrained.reason: Every shop supports brief quotes and numeric offers. C55's emphasis on fewer tokens does not establish lower actual conversational overhead, so retain the same tie-break.

raw_response.uncertainty: No evidence distinguishes expected surplus, settlement probability, or actual overhead. The rankings represent arbitrary tie-breaking among equivalent options.
